description: WORK is the SQL-standard synonym of TRANSACTION and Snowflake accepts it on all three transaction statements - live-verified for BEGIN WORK, COMMIT WORK and ROLLBACK WORK - naming the SAME transaction the plain spellings start and end, not a separate construct: BEGIN WORK commits with a plain COMMIT, a plain BEGIN ends with COMMIT WORK, and ROLLBACK WORK discards what BEGIN WORK started. The keyword stays an ordinary name, since live accepts a COLUMN and a TABLE called work, so admitting the spelling must not reserve the word. Converted 1:1 from transaction/TransactionStatementSpellingsTest (now retired).

steps.sql: SELECT work FROM kw_column WHERE work = 7
